import json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from src.tools.t01v2_live_progress import read_prefix,archive,observed_counts
from src.tools.t01_partition import ROOT
name=sys.argv[1]; parent='gen_test_config_round2_40_s01_retry2'
planfile=ROOT/'configs/gen_test_config_round2_40_s01_retry2_quota.json'
rawplan=planfile.read_bytes();expected='2bb1fd9d91723a591b2784ae7f243501d5e521302f04624c9a57670b03af7afe'
assert hashlib.sha256(rawplan).hexdigest()==expected
plan=json.loads(rawplan);assert plan['parent_run_name']==parent
folder=ROOT/'logs/runs'/name/'evidence';folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
rows=[]
for unit in plan['assignments']:
 scene=unit['scene'];child=parent+'_c6_'+scene.lower()
 row={'run_name':child,'scene':scene,'observed_counts':None,'ended':False,'scientific_acceptance':None}
 result=ROOT/'results'/(child+'.json')
 if result.exists():
  body=result.read_bytes();data=json.loads(body);m=data['metrics']
  row.update(ended=bool(data.get('_meta',{}).get('end')),source_file=str(result.relative_to(ROOT)),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),status=m.get('status'),error=m.get('error'),scene_excluded=m.get('scene_excluded'),reported_passed_by_class=m.get('passed_by_class'))
 journal=ROOT/'data/world_pairs/v2'/(child+'_attempts.jsonl')
 if journal.exists():
  raw,extent=read_prefix(journal);row.update(journal_prefix={**extent,'snapshot':archive(raw,folder,child+'.jsonl')},observed_counts=observed_counts(raw,scene))
 rows.append(row)
metrics={'snapshot_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scene_runs':rows,'scope':'complete archived journal-prefix producer-reported observations only; no independent scientific acceptance; unavailable sources remain unknown','task_acceptance':None}
config={'name':name,'parent':parent,'quota_plan_reference':{'file':str(planfile.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':expected},'snapshot_cap_per_source_bytes':8*1024*1024}
with (ROOT/'results'/(name+'.json')).open('x') as handle:json.dump({'config':config,'metrics':metrics},handle,indent=2);handle.write('\n')
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(metrics,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
